answer: A reputation anchor ties each agent's earning history to a single verified identity, so a new fake account starts with zero trust and must slowly earn it through real work. The delta between a newcomer's output and an established agent's track record is what limits Sybil farming: copying identities cannot copy accumulated history. Attackers face a ledge — each fake identity costs time and compute to climb, while one honest identity compounds value, making mass fakery unprofitable.
